content.title: How to watch Texas vs. Purdue men’s basketball: Sweet 16 TV channel and streaming options for March 26
content.text: A Sweet 16 battle features the No. 2 seed Purdue Boilermakers (29-8) squaring off against the No. 11 seed Texas Longhorns (21-14) on Thursday at SAP Center at San Jose. This NCAA Tournament matchup tips at 7:10 p.m., with the winner advancing to the West regional final.How to watch Texas Longhorns vs. Purdue Boilermakers Venue: SAP Center at San Jose Time: 7:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: CBS Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. It has a +446 scoring differential overall and outscores opponents by 12.1 points per game. Purdue knocks down 9.4 three-pointers per game (60th in college basketball) at a 38.8% rate (ninth-best in college basketball), compared to the 8.6 its opponents make while shooting 33.8% from beyond the arc. Texas has a +239 scoring differential, topping opponents by 6.8 points per game. It is putting up 82.9 points per game, 36th in college basketball, and is giving up 76.1 per outing to rank 238th in college basketball. Texas connects on 7.3 three-pointers per game (227th in college basketball) compared to its opponents’ 6.8. It shoots 35.3% from deep, and its opponents shoot 35.2%.
